title: Minecraft: Nightfall Shelter
story_hook: The sun is setting, Explorer! You need to build a shelter before nightfall. Can you survive the night?

tasks.instruction: Explorer, gather 5 sticks and 3 stones. Use your hands to pick them up.
Explorer, use the sticks and stones to build a small block-like base. Make it about 1 foot square.
Explorer, find 3 leaves. Use them to cover part of your block base.
Explorer, use the chalk to draw a circle around your shelter. Then, use the string to make a line from your shelter to the tree.

finale: You have built your shelter, Explorer! The night is coming. Observe your creation.
